description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This vital leadership role supports the Director of Nursing in overseeing clinical operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care and regulatory compliance. The ideal candidate will be passionate about making a difference in the lives of residents and contributing to a supportive team environment.

As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in staff supervision, quality assurance, and the implementation of care plans. This position offers an excellent opportunity for a skilled nursing professional to advance their leadership career within a dynamic healthcare setting. We value strong clinical judgment, effective communication, and a commitment to continuous improvement.
requirements: Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing experience, with some leadership or supervisory experience
Experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations
Excellent communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.
